limitations: DOM readiness is not a browser paint timestamp. Worker intervals include message transport, scheduling and observer overhead.
Version 1 totals include driver capture and file writes; they cannot be compared directly with version 2 readiness or reconstructed into its phases.
Each final browser workflow is one fresh run. Scheduling, JIT and solver deadlines can affect timing and geometry despite unchanged source.
Raw ignored artifacts are recorded with hashes; the versioned report retains all quality and page-clock timing results.
